payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design with interactive cursor effects. Use: custom cursor, cursor morphing on hover, magnetic cursor pull, cursor trails, blend mode cursors, click feedback animations, cursor as interaction tool, pointer transformation.
payload.best_for: Creative portfolios, interactive experiences, agency sites, product showcases, gaming, entertainment
payload.css_technical_keywords: cursor: none (custom), position: fixed for cursor element, mix-blend-mode: difference, transform on hover targets, magnetic effect (JS position lerp), trail with opacity fade, scale on click
payload.do_not_use_for: Mobile-first (no cursor), accessibility-critical, data-heavy dashboards, forms
payload.effects_and_animation: Cursor scale on hover, magnetic pull to elements, cursor morphing, trail effects, blend mode cursors, click feedback
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Custom cursor works, ☐ Hover morph smooth, ☐ Magnetic pull subtle, ☐ Trail performance ok, ☐ Click feedback visible, ☐ Touch fallback provided
payload.keywords: Custom cursor, cursor as tool, hover effects, cursor feedback, pointer transformation, cursor trail, magnetic cursor
payload.primary_colors: Brand-dependent, cursor accent color, high contrast for visibility
payload.secondary_colors: Trail colors, hover state colors, magnetic zone indicators, feedback colors
